problem_title: An upper-bound conjecture for weighted Hermite polynomials

evidence.text:
We prove Guo–Liu's full literal Hermite-envelope conjecture. A sine comparison gives enough strict energy loss in odd degree to attain the exact Gamma-normalized coefficient. A real-root moment inequality controls stationary peaks after the cutoff and supplies the clamped tail. Actual Rodrigues Hermite polynomials, the precise source cutoff and every assembly bridge are proved in Lean.See full solutionHide full solutionWe prove Guo–Liu's full literal Hermite-envelope conjecture.
